nodes.title: **Features & Benefits**
nodes.summary: Car loan features and benefits: loan amount up to ₹80 lakhs in India (equivalent in other regions), tenure of 12 to 84 months, interest rates starting from 8.25% p.a., disbursal within 48 hours of approval, flexible EMI repayment, eligibility for new and pre-owned cars plus electric vehicles, transparent processing with no hidden charges, and pre-approved offers for select ZX Bank customers.

nodes.title: **Eligibility**
nodes.summary: Eligibility criteria for the car loan: salaried individuals aged 21–60 with a minimum monthly income of ₹20,000, and self-employed individuals/professionals aged 21–65 with a minimum business vintage of 2 years, both varying by region.

nodes.title: **Documentation Required**
nodes.summary: Documents required: KYC proof (Aadhaar/Passport/Driving License, PAN, photograph), income proof such as salary slips/ITR/bank statements for the past 6 months, employment or business proof, and the vehicle quotation or invoice; all documents can be uploaded digitally via the ZX Bank Asia app or NetBanking.

nodes.title: **How to Apply**
nodes.summary: Describes the two ways to apply for a car loan: the recommended online route through the ZX Bank Asia app or NetBanking, and the offline route by visiting a ZX Bank branch with a relationship manager.

children.title: **Online (Recommended)**
children.summary: Online application steps: download the ZX Bank Asia app or log into ZX NetBanking, go to Loans then Car Loan, fill in personal and vehicle details, upload documents using e-KYC, check instant eligibility and available offers, and submit the application for quick processing and approval updates.

children.title: **Offline / Branch**
children.summary: Offline application: visit the nearest ZX Bank branch, meet a relationship manager for personalized assistance, and submit the completed car loan application and documents.

nodes.title: **Track Your Application**
nodes.summary: How to track a car loan application: use Track Applications in the ZX Bank Asia app or NetBanking, or chat with Zia, the AI assistant, for real-time loan status.

nodes.title: **Need Help?**
nodes.summary: Help options for the car loan: call 1800-123-4567 (India) or visit the contact page, and chat with Zia in the app; rates and eligibility criteria are indicative and may vary by region and applicant profile.
